description: Formatting hooks after every Edit/Write: format the changed file with prettier, gofmt, rustfmt, or black when found, whether or not the project uses that formatter; report trailing whitespace back to Claude; and check YAML syntax. Requires jq.

hooks.command: command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "ogxo-format/auto-format: jq not found; this hook is inactive. Install jq to enable it." >&2; exit 1; }; f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); [ -n "$f" ] && [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; case "$f" in *.js|*.jsx|*.ts|*.tsx|*.json|*.css|*.scss|*.md|*.html|*.yaml|*.yml) npx --no-install prettier --write "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true ;; *.go) gofmt -w "$f" 2>/dev/null || true ;; *.rs) rustfmt "$f" 2>/dev/null || true ;; *.py) black --quiet "$f" 2>/dev/null || true ;; esac

command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "ogxo-format/trailing-whitespace: jq not found; this hook is inactive. Install jq to enable it." >&2; exit 1; }; f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); [ -n "$f" ] && [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; case "$f" in *.md|*.markdown|*.diff|*.patch) exit 0 ;; esac; lines=$(grep -nE '[[:blank:]]+$' "$f" 2>/dev/null | head -5); if [ -n "$lines" ]; then echo "Trailing whitespace in $f — remove it (line:content): $(printf '%s' "$lines" | tr '\n' ' ')" >&2; exit 2; fi

command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "ogxo-format/yaml-validate: jq not found; this hook is inactive. Install jq to enable it." >&2; exit 1; }; f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.yml|*.yaml) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; python3 -c 'import yaml' 2>/dev/null || exit 0; err=$(python3 -c 'import sys,yaml; list(yaml.compose_all(open(sys.argv[1]), Loader=yaml.SafeLoader))' "$f" 2>&1) || { echo "YAML syntax error in $f: $err" >&2; exit 2; }
